Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That is all we have from this game. The series is off to a good start for the Aussies and would want to win the next game too. But expect Sri Lanka to do better in the next game as they get used to the conditions. The second T20I will be played on 13th February. The first ball will be bowled at 1:40 pm IST (8:10 am GMT). But join us in advance for the buildup. Cheers for now!
Adam Zampa has been named the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his spell of 4-0-18-3!

The Aussie bowling was on point and they had a great time. Josh Hazlewood had an excellent return as he bagged a four-fer. Adam Zampa like always was amongst the wickets and picked up 3. Mitchell Starc and Pat Cummins were a bit expensive but the others covered well for them. Their batting was quite average as they lost a bunch of wickets in the death overs but they did get a decent score on the board.

The Powerplay was going to be key for Sri Lanka but they failed to make use of it. They lost the two wickets and also did not score freely. Then there was a stand between Pathum Nissanka and Charith Asalanka which did steady the ship but they needed to up the ante once they were set. Both the batters fell to Adam Zampa in the 11th over and after that, it was a collapse. There were a few starts for their batters but none went onto make it big and that is what cost them the game.

A very convincing win for the Aussies and once again their strong bowling unit has come to the rescue. We felt they had an under-par score to defend but they have used the conditions brilliantly and defended well.
Yorker, on off. Dinesh Chandimal works it to long on for one. That ends the game and Australia win by 20 runs (D/L method)!
FOUR! A high full toss, on off. Dinesh Chandimal looks to swipe it away but gets the top edge over short third man for a boundary. Not called a no ball.
A full toss, on off. Chipped towards extra cover.
SIX! Smoked but too late! Length ball, wide outside off. Dinesh Chandimal carves it all the way over the cover fence.

Yorker, on off. Binura Fernando blocks it to short cover. He wants a single but is sent back. The fielder underarms the ball at the keeper's end but misses. Now, the batters a single off the overthrow.
Length ball, outside off. Heaved towards long on for one.
Back of a length, on off. Chandimal looks to swipe it across the line but gets hit on the pads. It rolls away and a leg bye is taken.
Length ball, on off. Pushed past cover for one.
Shorter and outside off. Dinesh Chandimal miscues the pull in the air. The ball lands short of the man at deep mid-wicket. Single.
Back of a length, on the body. Dinesh Chandimal misses the heave and gets hit on the body.
Length and outside off. Dinesh Chandimal goes for the drive but gets the outside edge over short third man. Zampa chases it, dives and keeps it to two.
Binura Fernando walks out.
OUT! TAKEN! Shorter, on the body. Dushmantha Chameera goes for the pull but gets the top edge. Ben McDermott runs towards the square leg region from mid-wicket and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Ben McDermott b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Another boundary for Dinesh Chandimal! Short and on the body. He pulls it away. The man at deep mid-wicket runs to his right and dives but gets no hand on it.
Back of a length, around off. Dushmantha Chameera heaves it towards the mid on region. Just a single to bring up Sri Lanka's 100.
Back of a length, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal hops up and cuts it over backward point for one.
FOUR! Dinesh Chandimal gets a boundary! Length ball, on off. Heaved in the air and past deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Dushmantha Chameera gets the inside edge on the pads. The ball rolls away and they take a quick single.
On a length, on off. Dushmantha Chameera swings across the line but misses it.
Shorter and outside off. Slapped to long on for one.
Length ball, on off. Worked past square leg for a couple. Dushmantha Chameera is off the mark.
Dushmantha Chameera is the next batter. Sri Lanka need 53 from 20.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Back of a length, on off. Chamika Karunaratne looks to work it to the leg side but gets it off the shoulder of the bat. It pops back to the bowler and Josh Hazlewood gets forward to take it.
A late review! On a length, outside off. Chamika Karunaratne misses his drive. Looks like they reviewed it for caught behind. But there is no bat on it.
Very full, on off. Drilled to long on for one.
OUT! TAKEN! Another one falls! Length ball, on off. Dasun Shanaka lifts it straight towards mid off. Aaron Finch moves back a bit and takes it. Chamika Karunaratne is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Aaron Finch b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Josh Hazlewood is back.
Loopy ball, on off. Played back to the bowler by Dinesh Chandimal. Zampa ends with figures of 4-0-18-3.
So we are back. The players are out in the middle. The target is now 143 in 19 overs for Sri Lanka. Zampa to finish his spell.

Update 5:15 pm IST (11:45 am GMT) - Oops, the drizzle is getting heavier and off go the players! Oh, hang on. Looks like the batters are walking back in. Nope, they are walking off as the rain has gotten heavier. Now, the covers are being peeled off as the rain got lighter! We have lost one over here.
Googly, around off. Dinesh Chandimal gets the inside edge on the pads.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
Dinesh Chandimal is in now. 61 needed in 33.
OUT! TAKEN! Adam Zampa gets another! Tossed up, around off. Wanindu Hasaranga looks to go over covers but ends up slicing over cover. Steven Smith moves back and takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off. Left alone and called a wide.
Dasun Shanaka comes down the track and plays it to long on for one.
Wanindu Hasaranga backs away so Adam Zampa follows him with a flatter one. The ball goes towards backward point as Wanindu Hasaranga misses the flick. Runs given, so maybe there was some bat on it.
On a length, around off. Dasun looks to punch it but gets the inside edge on the pads.
A slower bouncer, around leg. Dasun Shanaka misses the pull. Dot ball.
Slower, shorter and outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga waits for it and taps it to cover. A single is taken and the fielder misses his shy at the keeper's end.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Sri Lanka! Shorter, on off. Wanindu Hasaranga backs away and tonks it past mid off for a boundary.
Shorter, outside off. Dasun Shanaka pulls it towards deep square leg for one. The required run rate has crossed 10 per over now.
Shorter and outside off. Slapped to deep point for one.
Pat Cummins (2-0-14-1) is back on.
FOUR BYES! That has beaten everything! Flatter, on middle and leg. Dasun Shanaka gets down the track and misses his flick. Even Wade cannot collect it and the ball runs to the fence.
Shorter, on off. Wanindu Hasaranga rocks back and slaps it to long off for one.
A bit of charge and Zampa bowls it shorter, outside off. This is worked past point for a single.
Fuller, on middle. Dasun Shanaka paddles it towards fine leg for a couple.
Tossed up, on off. Wanindu Hasaranga slogs it towards long on for one.
Shorter, outside off. Slapped past point for a couple.
Play and a miss! Back of a length, around off. Dasun Shanaka misses the pull. Just 3 from the over.

A bit of drizzle around. Very, very light though. Also, Australia are a bit behind on time. The rule apparently is that if you don't bowl the overs in a stipulated time, you need to have fewer fielders outside the ring towards the end. Australia are one over behind currently.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
Length ball, outside off. Dasun Shanaka looks to play it down the ground but gets the leading edge over covers. The batters take two.
On a length, on middle. Dasun Shanaka plays it to mid-wicket. Dot again!
A single as this is worked past cover.
Full, on off. Blocked to cover. Wanindu Hasaranga wants a single but is sent back.

NOT OUT! Dasun Shanaka is safe! Tossed up, on off. He looks to block but it turns away and goes past the bat. The bails are taken off and there is an appeal for stumping. The TV umpire checks it and Dasun Shanaka is safe.
Is that a wicket? The TV umpire will check this for a stumping. First, he checks if there is an edge on it. Doesn't look like it though. Now, the stumping. Dasun Shanaka is safe.
Loopy ball, on off. Worked to long on for one.
Dasun Shanaka is the new man. Sri Lanka have two brand new batters out there.

OUT! TAKEN! Adam Zampa gets another one! Australia are in firm control now! Tossed up, on off. Charith Asalanka plays the slog sweep and connects it quite well. But Steven Smith runs to his left from deep mid-wicket and takes a really good catch at the edge of the ropes. A game-changing over.
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, lands outside off and comes back in. Charith Asalanka looks to block but gets the inside edge on the pads.
Wanindu Hasaranga is the next batter. 86 needed in 58.

OUT! TAKEN! Good catch by Mitchell Starc! The set batter is gone. Pathum Nissanka played a lot of dot balls but kept the scoreboard ticking. Very full again, on middle. He goes to slog sweep but gets the top edge. Mitchell Starc runs to his right and runs forward from long on. He slides in the end to take the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Starc b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Pumped! Very full, on middle. Pathum Nissanka clears his front and heaves it wide of long on. It runs to the fence.
Adam Zampa is back. 3 from his first over.
Length ball, on off. Blocked out by Charith. 8 from that over.
A single as this is worked to third man again.
FOUR! Another lucky boundary for Sri Lanka! Bouncer and Pathum Nissanka goes for the pull. It takes the top edge and runs to the fence.
Back of a length, around off. Charith Asalanka taps it with soft hands to cover for a quick single.
Length and down the leg side. Charith Asalanka misses the flick. Wide called.
Shorter, on the body. Charith Asalanka is cramped for room and plays it towards mid-wicket.
On a length, around off. Glided down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary for Sri Lanka! A lucky one though. Short and outside off. Charith Asalanka throws his bat at it but gets the outside edge. It runs to the third man fence. 15 from the over.
Very full, on the pads. Worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! That is really well done! Short and on the body. Charith Asalanka tucks it wide of deep backward square leg for a boundary. A bit of Sanath Jayasuriya in that stroke!
Low full toss, outside off. Pathum Nissanka goes for the drive but gets the outside edge to third man for one.

FOUR! Pathum Nissanka gets a move on now! A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Pathum Nissanka clears his front leg and tonks it. He doesn't middle it but it goes over mid off and runs to the fence.
Very full, on off. Driven to long on for one.
That slipped out of the hands! A high full toss, down the leg side. Charith Asalanka is taken by surprise and ends up looking to duck under it. It goes down the leg side. Wide called.
Mitchell Starc is back on. 13 from his first 2 overs.
Tossed up, on the pads. Charith Asalanka clips it to the mid-wicket region. The fielder runs in from the fence and keeps it to one.
Shorter, on off. Pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Pathum Nissanka dances down the track to work it away but gets it off the toe end back to the bowler.
Flatter, outside off. Pathum Nissanka goes for the big reverse sweep but misses.
Googly, on middle. Pathum Nissanka drops it towards square leg looking for a single but is set back.
Flatter, on off. Tapped wide of short third man. The fielder moves to his right and keeps it to one.
Time for some spin. Adam Zampa will bowl now.
This is cut away by Charith Asalanka. But Steven Smith dives to his left and backward point and gets his hands to it. Single taken then.
Shorter and outside off. Pathum Nissanka cuts it to third man for one.
Full and on the pads. Clipped past mid-wicket for one.
On a length, on off. Blocked out from the crease by Charith Asalanka.
Shorter and outside off. Pathum Nissanka plays it past backward point for one.
Length ball, on off. Worked to mid-wicket. Dot again.
A single as this length ball is worked to square leg. That ends the Powerplay and Sri Lanka are struggling at 30 for 2.
On a length, on off. Charith Asalanka goes for the pull but gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball goes to third man and they get a leg bye. An appeal but it was too high.
On a length, outside off. Punched past point for a single.
Length ball, on the pads. Pathum Nissanka misses the flick. The ball clips the pads and rolls to short fine leg.
Shorter and wide outside off. Charith Asalanka goes for the cut but gets the outside edge. The ball goes aerially but lands short of third man.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
Josh Hazlewood (1-0-1-1) is back.
On a length, around off. Pathum Nissanka runs it to short third man.

DROPPED! What has happened there? As soon as Pathum Nissanka hit it, he thought he was out! Back of a length, on the body. The pull shot is miscued and balloons towards mid on. Pat Cummins runs in and gets in a good position but drops a dolly! Should have been the third wicket there.
FOUR! Good shot! Pathum Nissanka dances down the track to this length ball, outside off. He drives it past mid off and gets a boundary.
Slower ball, on a length, on middle. Pathum Nissanka misses the pull and gets hit on the body. The ball goes back to the keeper.
On a length, on off. Tapped to backward point for one. Charith Asalanka is off the mark.
Beaten! Length ball, angling across off. Charith Asalanka looks to block but is beaten.
Marcus Stoinis is on now.
Length, on middle. Pathum Nissanka taps it to backward point. He wants a single but is sent back. Just that one maximum and a wicket from the over then.
Back of a length, on the body. Worked to short fine leg.
Shorter, outside off. Pathum Nissanka misses the cut.
Charith Asalanka is out there now. 129 needed in 99.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Pat Cummins gets his revenge! He bangs it shorter, on the body. Avishka Fernando goes for the pull but gets the top edge. The ball goes high in the air towards the short fine leg region. Matthew Wade moves in that direction, dives forward in the end and takes it! Sri Lanka lose another big wicket. The target is not very big so they should bat sensibly here.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! What a way to get off the mark! Short and on the body. He rocks back and simply picks it up over the square leg fence. The dugout is happy!
Change. Pat Cummins is on now.
Length ball, outside off. Avishka Fernando pokes at it but misses.
Very full, on off. Blocked out.
SIX! NAILED! THAT IS NAILED! A massive strike! On a length, on the body. Pathum Nissanka smokes it over the mid-wicket fence. Great shot.
A yorker, slower yorker at that. On off and Pathum Nissanka digs it out.
FOUR! Lovely stroke! Length ball, on off. Pathum Nissanka backs away before the ball is bowled and frees his arms. The ball goes over covers and reaches the fence.
Off the mark! Very full, on off. Pathum Nissanka goes for the whip but gets it off the inner half past deep square leg for a couple.
Pathum Nissanka is yet to get off the mark! Full, on off. Driven to mid off.
Avishka Fernando walks out now.

OUT! TAKEN! This was coming! The pressure was building up and something had to happen! Length ball, on middle. Danushka Gunathilaka looks to heave it across the line but gets it off the inner half to short mid-wicket. Marcus Stoinis takes an easy catch there.
Commentary.Howout: c Marcus Stoinis b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around off. Pushed to point.
Play and a miss again! Length ball, on middle. Danushka Gunathilaka shuffles across and looks to scoop but misses. A really good start for Australia.
Play and a miss! Length ball, angling across off. Danushka Gunathilaka misses his push.
Length ball, lands on off and comes back in. Nissanka gets hit on the pads and it rolls away to the off side. Leg bye taken.
On a length, on middle. Worked past square leg for an easy single.
Josh Hazlewood will bowl now.

Appeal for caught behind! A bumper, on middle. Pathum Nissanka goes for the pull but misses. The Aussies are quite interested but Starc is not really appealing. Finch is really excited but the umpire turns it down. There is a spike on UltraEdge but it might have been the ball clipping the helmet.
A bit fuller, outside off. Pathum Nissanka strides and nicely drives it to mid off.
Play and a miss! Shorter, outside off. Nissanka goes for the slash but the ball goes his bat. Dot again.
On a length, on off. Defended to cover again.
Very full, around off. Pushed nicely to cover.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off. Pathum Nissanka misses the cut.
Length ball, lands on middle and shapes down the leg side. Pathum Nissanka misses the flick. Wide called.
